summary: Iter10 — end-to-end testing of the 3 NEW features (Team multi-user, Fleet Command Center, accept-invite public page). Backend: 22/22 tests pass on /api/team/* and /api/fleets/* covering members list, invitations CRUD+lookup+accept+revoke, fleet CRUD, reorder-suggestions (verified gold-tier price < retail), and auth negatives. Full iter9 regression: 10/10 pass (public stats, catalog, auth/me, VIN passport, PDF). Frontend: /team renders with invite form (email+role dropdown+Send), OWNER badge on Test WS, members list; /fleets renders with 'New fleet' button, vehicle chips, 'Show one-tap reorder list'; sidebar has Team + Fleets nav; /accept-invite?token=invalid shows 'Invitation not found'. Zero horizontal overflow at 320/360/768/1440 viewports on both pages.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by the visual-editor instrumentation wrapping the role label in a <span data-ve-dynamic> inside each <option>. Functional: select still works and invitations submit. Benign dev warning but floods console. Suggest wrapping role option text in a plain string (not inside a visual-editor span) or adding an x-excluded boundary around the label.

action_items: (Optional LOW) Silence the React hydration warning on Team.jsx role <select> — the visual-editor span wrapper should be suppressed inside <option>. Non-blocking but pollutes console.
(Carry-over from iter8/iter9) Verify joy_id counter fix (was P0); still open per iter9 notes.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/team.py _is_owner handles both legacy ws.user_id and new ws.owner_user_id — defensive and correct. remove_member refuses to remove the owner (400) and also 404s when member_user_id not in member_user_ids. Good.

routes/team.py accept_invitation: the auto-detach of a pre-existing placeholder workshop (orders==0 path) silently deletes workshops.user_id==inv.workshop_id mismatched — make sure workshop_id is uniquely assigned so this never deletes the actual target workshop. Current filter {'user_id': user.user_id, 'workshop_id': {'$ne': inv.workshop_id}} looks safe.

routes/fleets.py reorder-suggestions builds member_ids including BOTH ws.user_id and user.user_id — harmless but the set() dedupe handles the overlap. tier_price correctly applied; suggested_qty formula divides by vehicle_count (floor min=1) — reasonable heuristic.
routes/fleets.py update_fleet calls `await get_fleet(fleet_id, request)` at the end — re-runs auth. Acceptable but slightly redundant; minor perf.

Team.jsx <option> hydration warning: Visual-editor instrumentation injects a <span> inside <option>. Consider wrapping ROLE_OPTIONS map in a string template or adding a suppressHydrationWarning/x-excluded boundary.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (Team page, Fleets page, accept-invite public, sidebar nav, responsive at 4 viewports)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter10 features fully verified. Use /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_team_fleets.py as regression. To re-run, ensure: (a) user u-invitee-1 exists with session tok-invitee in test_database; (b) test-token-workshop-1 session is not expired; (c) workshop test-workshop-1 has owner_user_id backfilled. The TestInvitations class is stateful (depends on previous tests), keep as a single class. ReorderSuggestions test will pass with empty list if workshop has no orders — current DB has data so len>0 verified. The only open UI polish is the React hydration warning from visual-editor instrumentation inside <option>. Everything else is green.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Hydration warning root cause: visual-editor build-time instrumentation wraps the role label in a <span data-ve-dynamic> which is not legal inside <option>. Fix would be to mark the label expression as x-excluded or refactor options to build label as a plain string outside the visual-editor touched path.
